discovery: Previously opened flying-height individuality in 2021 Larus fuscus; 2021 device audit found same-bird re-tagging unavailable, constant-zero barometric height, but abundant ground-speed<=0.5m/s records.
scientific_question: Can at-rest/slow-moving GPS altitude within the same small horizontal space show repeatable tag/individual-associated shape independent of flight behavior?
nonconfirmatory_status: POST_OUTCOME_NEGATIVE_CONTROL_FEASIBILITY - never count as external taxonomic replication or calibration of a biological causal mechanism

selection.native: 2021 May-July UTC, exclude source-marked outliers, finite WGS84 x-y, ground-speed 0-0.5m/s inclusive, first selected fix per bird/date/UTC 5min bin; do not use height for selection.
selection.daily_cell: select modal 100m cell from each bird-day by count, tie broken deterministic numeric x/y; other-cell days ignored for primary. At 500m repeat independently from the same selected 5-min record set.
selection.donor_days_only: Only qualifying >=20-bin same-cell bird-days form comparison pools. Do not use short donor days.
selection.null_preconditioning: No heights are inspected and no final test is performed at structural stage.

interpretation.positive_support: Reanalysis of stationary height distributions still cannot distinguish tag artifact from repeated micro-roost/perch placement within 100m.
interpretation.negative_support: Lack of a stationary signal does not exclude movement-specific GPS altitude error.
interpretation.not_admitted: Structural lack of overlap is unavailable, not evidence absence of tag-specific errors.

next_allowed: If 100m primary gate meets >=10 biological birds with repeat days, freeze a stationary centered-altitude-shape descriptive/label-null test and execute; otherwise do not widen primary to 500m to rescue.
